1/ So I wanted to see how far an H Company agent could get on a job that costs money: checking whether a product has been recalled. I built it on H Company (https://hcompany.ai) and let it pay for the data itself.

Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7PkMvaeUX8A

---

2/ I gave it a Peloton Tread+ and asked for a recall check. On its own it found a recalls service in the Nevermined catalog, paid for the lookup, got the real 2021 regulator recall, then paid a model to write the brief. No signups, no keys.

---

3/ The point: an H Company agent can act, but it had no way to pay for an outside service on its own. The catalog is the missing piece. One key, one budget, ~160 services, pay per call for the one it needs.

---

4/ The one thing I watched was money. I set the budget on my Nevermined account, the agent cannot raise it, and I can revoke it in one action. For an agent acting on its own, that cap is the safety net.

Write-up: https://nevermined.ai/blog/hcompany-catalog-recall-agent?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=hcompany-catalog-recall-agent
